bank.title: Link your bank.
bank.lead: Your transactions arrive on their own and your balance matches the bank's. Your credentials go straight to the aggregator, never to Finnit.

ai.title: AI sorts it out.
ai.lead: It categorizes your spending, recognizes your merchants, spots transfers between your accounts and learns from every correction. You just decide.

hero.srTitle: Snap a receipt, add a screenshot, link your bank and let AI sort it out: Finnit does the math.

features.eyebrow: AI as a tool, not a gimmick
features.title: Every tedious part of your finances, handled.
features.lead: Finnit does the repetitive work so you can see the whole picture.

receipts.title: From receipt to expense
receipts.body: Take a photo of a receipt or invoice. Finnit reads the CFDI, the merchant and the total, and leaves the expense ready to confirm.

screenshots.title: Bank screenshots
screenshots.body: Share a screenshot of your banking app's transactions and Finnit turns them into records, even the ones still pending.

categorize.title: Categories that learn
categorize.body: Every correction teaches Finnit. It recognizes your usual merchants and only asks about new ones.

banks.title: Bank connection
banks.body: Sync your accounts securely: your credentials go straight to the bank aggregator, never to our servers.

debts.title: Loans and cards under control
debts.body: Payment calendar, interest, interest-free installments and how much is left to pay off each debt.

reconcile.title: Balances that add up
reconcile.body: Finnit compares your balance with your bank's and points out the difference before it becomes a mystery.

step1.title: Connect or capture
step1.body: Link your bank, snap a receipt or share a screenshot of your transactions.

step2.title: AI sorts it out
step2.body: Finnit identifies merchant, amount, account and category, and spots transfers between your own accounts.

step3.title: Decide with clarity
step3.body: Review, confirm and see what you have, what you owe and which payments are coming.

preview.title: Your whole month, on one screen.
preview.lead: Real balance, upcoming payments and transactions already categorized. Without opening five banking apps.
preview.tipAfter: eating out. You're on track for your savings goal.

files.title: Private files
files.body: Your receipts and statements are kept in private storage and only you can see them. There are never public links.

credentials.title: Credentials out of our reach
credentials.body: Your bank username and password never go through Finnit; they go straight to the bank aggregator.

control.title: AI suggests, you decide
control.body: Nothing is recorded without your confirmation, and you can correct any suggestion.

cta.title: Be among the first to use Finnit.
cta.lead: We're opening by invitation. Leave your email and we'll let you know when it's your turn.

form.label: Email
form.note: We'll only write to let you know. No spam.
form.success: You're in! We'll let you know as soon as we open.

errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.failed: We couldn't save your email. Try again.

footer.tagline: AI personal finance. Made in Mexico.

calendar.title: Payments calendar
calendar.subtitle: When each payment is due, what you already paid and how much goes to fixed expenses.

summary.monthsHint: Scheduled recurring payments and loans. Cards count today’s debt on their next due date; the months after don’t include it.
summary.perMonthHint: Monthly cost of your active payments.
